meaning: One large order, placed reasonably recently.
recommended_action: The most promising conversion target: the spend is there, the habit is not. Post-purchase follow-up and category cross-sell.

meaning: One good order, long ago, never returned.
recommended_action: Worth a reactivation test - the order value justifies the cost.

meaning: One order, recently. Value not yet established.
recommended_action: Second-purchase programme, triggered from delivery rather than from a calendar date.
Low-cost automated reactivation only. Do not spend here.

meaning: One order, middling on both recency and value.
recommended_action: The bulk of the base. Address through broad lifecycle automation rather than targeted spend.

meaning: Bought more than once, recently, and spent well. Rare here.
recommended_action: Protect and study. This group is the proof repeat is possible - find what they have in common and target it.

meaning: Bought more than once but have gone quiet.
recommended_action: Highest-value win-back target. They already proved they will come back once; the second return is cheaper than a new customer.

meaning: More than one order, mid recency and value.
recommended_action: Nurture towards a third order - the point where a customer starts to look like a relationship rather than a transaction.
